name: Latis
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Latis is a Continental goddess in the Celtic record. Little is known about her. Scholars read her as a goddess of beer. Others tie her to holy wells. Her cult is not well documented.

okr.objective: State the known role of the goddess Latis.
key_results: She was a Continental Celtic goddess.
Some readers tie her to holy wells.
